objective: Acquire genuine external evidence without converting research CI or self-signed claims into independent scientific proof.

stage_E1.goal: External GitHub-hosted rerun of 14 frozen G1 synthetic tests and a separate hashlib/tarfile byte oracle
stage_E1.activation: Explicit single-use RUN_EXTERNAL_INTENT.json commit on isolated research branch only; no automatic production/PR/main triggers
acceptance: GitHub API shows genuine completed successful run on same commit SHA
Job log shows github-hosted Ubuntu runner, frozen source/plan byte hashes match, 14/14 unchanged tests pass
Retrieve downloadable run artifact, verify SHA256 and separately durable-commit receipt
stage_E1.cost_constraint: Before intent commit verify included GitHub Actions minutes and account hard $0 paid-spend block. A private repo on GitHub Free may consume included minutes; zero additional charges not guaranteed until account billing checked.

stage_E2.goal: Fresh evaluation cases with a custodian external to the candidate and demonstrable lack of developer access until freeze
stage_E2.strong_route: Named independent human/organization maintains private cases and grading code, externally pins SHA256, freezes permissions and attests timestamp, releases only signed aggregate outcomes and sufficient audit proof after candidate+baseline freeze
stage_E2.conditional_automated_route: For tasks with mathematical/deterministic oracles, freeze public generator and scoring code before the future signed drand/NIST beacon pulse, bind first predetermined post-freeze pulse and use that seed for fresh cases. This is temporal independence of case selection, not independent organizational custody; validate beacon cryptographic signature before reliance.

stage_E3.goal: Actually matched model/system evaluation with immutable provider model/revision metadata
hard_requirements: Observed provider response model identifier AND supported immutable revision or equivalent provider attestation
Same actual selected model/revision, task clusters, resources, tools and scorer; if not possible declare mismatched treatment
Externally enforce token/tool/time budgets; persist provider-returned request IDs, model IDs, usage and timing
Independent scorer/custodian and predeclared sample size, margins and family coverage
stage_E3.zero_cost_route: Only if already available API trial/granted credits cover selected model and repeated runs; ChatGPT Plus is not API credit. Otherwise no $0 confirmatory model claim.
stage_E3.alternative: Manual ChatGPT Plus randomized blind development comparison can inform design but not supply immutable provider snapshot nor trusted machine-observed usage.
stage_E3.no_unavailable_astra_alias: Do not invent gpt-6-astra API access or an unlisted immutable model snapshot.

rejected_shortcuts: Duplicate Ed25519 keys operated by one person are not independent custody
GitHub-hosted execution of self-authored tests is not an independent scorer
Private GitHub Free artifact attestations are not available; link to GitHub Actions run and digest instead
GitHub Models inference API unavailable after 2026-07-30 retirement
Do not publish any QROS private scientific data or hidden benchmarks to make public attestation free
next_action: Make E1 reproducible without automatic execution. To run: verify included-minute balance and set GitHub Actions paid spend hard stop at $0, then create single-use intent commit on research branch. Read back GitHub run/job and artifact; E2/E3 remain independently gated.
